textLineBreaks: (function () { var userAgent = navigator.userAgent; var browser; if (userAgent.match(/firefox|fxios/i)) { browser = { url: "https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/web-scraper/", name: "Firefox", icon: "firefox", }; } else if (userAgent.match(/edg/i)) { browser = { url: "https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/web-scraper-free-web-sc/jfmdjnnfminejadhegajcjbpgjofnkaj", name: "Edge", icon: "edge", }; } else { browser = { url: "https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/web-scraper/jnhgnonknehpejjnehehllkliplmbmhn?hl=en", name: "Chrome", icon: "chrome", }; } document.querySelectorAll(".install-extension").forEach(function (button) { button.setAttribute("href", browser.url); var icon = button.querySelector(".browser-icon"); if (icon) { icon.className = icon.className.replace(/ws-icon-chrome-(500|dark)/g, "ws-icon-" + browser.icon + "-$1"); } }); document.querySelectorAll(".browser-name").forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = browser.name; }); })();
